description_en: Queries the government document library based on complex conditions
description_zh: 根据复杂条件进行政务公文库的检索
name: ListDocumentRetrieve

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the Model Studio workspace. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2782167.html
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of results to return
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The token for the next page
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The article type. Valid values:
0 or null: All. This is the default value.
1: Official document.
2: Important article.
5: Policy interpretation.
6: Legal provision.
7: Rule and regulation.
8: General Secretary
parameters.help_zh: 文章体裁，0（null）:全部(默认值),  1：公文，2：重要文章  5:政策解读 6：法律条文 7：规章法规 8：总书记
parameters.name: content_type

parameters.help_en:
The subtype of the article type. Valid values:
When the article type is General Secretary:
1: News.
2: Speech.
3: Thought.
4: Theory.
When the article type is Official document:
-1: Other.
0: Resolution.
1: Decision.
2: Order.
3: Communiqué.
4: Announcement.
5: Notice.
6: Opinion.
7: Circular.
8: Bulletin.
9: Report.
10: Request for instructions.
11: Reply.
12: Bill.
13: Letter.
14: Minutes.
When the article type is Important article:
1: Important commentary.
2: Important theory.
3: Other article.
When the article type is Rule and regulation:
3: Administrative regulation.
4: Supervisory regulation.
5: Local regulation.
7: Departmental rule.
8: Other.
9: Party constitution and rules.
When the article type is Legal provision:
1: Constitution.
2: Law.
6: Judicial interpretation
parameters.help_zh:
文章体裁二级分类，文章体裁为总书记时：1：动态 2：讲话 3：思想 4：理论
     * 文章体裁为公文时：-1： 其他 0：决议 1：决定 2：令 3：公报 4：公告 5：通告 6：意见 7：通知 8：通报 9：报告 10：请示 11：批复 12： 议案 13：函
     * 14： 纪要
     * 文章体裁为重要文章时：1：重要评论 2：重要理论 3：其他文章
     * 文章体裁为规章法规时：3：行政法规 4：监察法规 5：地方性法规 7：部门规章 8：其他 9：党章党规
     * 文章体裁为法律条文时：1：宪法 2：法律 6：司法解释
parameters.name: sub_content_type

parameters.help_en: The region. You can enter a province or a city, such as Jilin Province or Beijing Municipality
parameters.help_zh: 区域 可直接输入 省 或者市 如吉林省 或者北京市
parameters.name: region

parameters.help_en:
The source. Valid values:
0: Internal (current organization).
1: External (other organizations)
parameters.help_zh: 来源，0：内部（本单位） 1：外部（外单位）
parameters.name: source

parameters.help_en: The start date of issuance. Format: yyyy-MM-dd
parameters.name: start_date

parameters.help_en: The end date of issuance. Format: yyyy-MM-dd
parameters.name: end_date

parameters.help_en:
The search scope. Valid values:
1: Title.
0: Full text (title and content). This is the default value
parameters.help_zh: 检索要素范围，1:标题  0:全文(标题和内容)，默认
parameters.name: element_scope

parameters.help_en:
The subject classification. The following classifications are supported:
| Primary classification | Secondary classification |
|---|---|
| National defense, exchange, and cooperation affairs | National defense, Foreign affairs, Military work, Hong Kong, Macao, Taiwan, and overseas Chinese affairs |
| Comprehensive government affairs | 20th CPC National Congress, Government transparency and supervision, Joint government affairs, Party building, Meetings and proposals, Government document management, Other government affairs |
| State Council organizational structure | State Council, General Office of the State Council, State Council agencies |
| Administrative and market supervision | Administrative supervision, Credit supervision, Product quality supervision, Work safety supervision, Market supervision |
| Economic management | National economy, Market economy, Economic system reform, State-owned asset supervision |
| Finance, financial, and commercial affairs | Finance, Financial affairs, Audit, Commerce, Customs |
| Personnel work and social security | Personnel work, Population and family planning, Women and children work, Poverty alleviation, Disaster reduction and relief, Public services, Social welfare and assistance, Preferential treatment and placement, Social security |
| Public security and social management | Public security, Security, Justice, Firefighting, Ethnic affairs, Religion |
| Science, education, culture, and sports | Culture, Scientific and technological innovation, Education, Intellectual property, Press and publication, Radio, television, and Internet, Sports, Tourism |
| Medical and health care | Health, Medical care, Veterinary medicine |
| Urban and rural construction and industrial development | Urban and rural construction, Industry, Transportation |
| Natural resources and environmental protection | Land and resources, energy, Civil engineering, Meteorology, Environmental protection |
| Agriculture, forestry, water conservancy, fishery, and animal husbandry | Agriculture, Forestry, Water conservancy, Fishery, Animal husbandry |
| Other | Other |
parameters.help_zh:
支持如下分类
|  一级分类    |  二级分类 |
|  ----  | ----  |
| 国防和交流合作事务 | 国防, 对外事务, 军事工作, 港澳台侨工作 |
| 综合政务 | 二十大, 政务公开与督查, 联合政务, 党建工作, 会议及提案, 政务文件管理, 其他政务 |
| 国务院组织机构 | 国务院, 国务院办公厅, 国务院机构 |
| 行政监管与市场监管 | 行政监管, 信用监管, 产品质量监督, 安全生产监管, 市场监管 |
| 经济管理 | 国民经济, 市场经济, 经济体制改革, 国有资产监管 |
| 财政金融商贸 | 财政, 金融, 审计, 商贸, 海关 |
| 人事工作与社会保障 | 人事工作, 人口与计划生育, 妇女儿童工作, 扶贫, 减灾救灾, 公共服务, 社会福利与救助, 优抚安置, 社会保障 |
| 公共安全与社会管理 | 公安, 安全, 司法, 消防, 民族, 宗教 |
| 科教文体 | 文化, 科技创新, 教育, 知识产权, 新闻出版, 广电与互联网, 体育, 旅游 |
| 医疗卫生 | 卫生, 医疗, 动物医学 |
| 城乡建设与工业发展 | 城乡建设, 工业, 交通 |
| 自然资源与环境保护 | 国土资源、能源, 土木, 气象, 环境保护 |
| 农林水渔牧类 | 农业, 林业, 水利, 渔业, 畜牧业 |
| 其他 | 其他 |
parameters.name: subject_classify
